relationships.evidence_quote: In the late inflammatory phase, CGRP upregulates thrombospondin-1, promotes neutrophil apoptosis and phagocytic clearance

key_findings: CGRP remains persistently low in diabetic wound tissue, disrupting neuro-immune communication and prolonging inflammation.
Restoring CGRP signaling may improve wound repair and relieve diabetic neuropathic pain.
